title: Non-Reciprocal Chiral Dissipative Soliton Time Crystals and Sub-Picosecond Topological Ising Machines in Driven Nonlinear Ring Resonators

creators.name: Ownby, Gracen
creators.affiliation: University of Oklahoma, Norman, Oklahoma, USA

description: Complete analytical proofs, reproducible simulation scripts, 2,000-cavity Monte Carlo verification datasets, standalone TikZ vector figures, and compiled LaTeX manuscript for Paper VI of the 6-Paper Theoretical Physics & Quantum Engineering Series. Establishes Theorem 1 (non-reciprocal asymmetric soliton wake eigenvalues kappa_+ != kappa_-, broken action-reaction F_{1->2} != -F_{2->1}, and non-Hermitian Hopf-Turing bifurcation to a Chiral Dissipative Soliton Time Crystal with odd elasticity), Corollary 1 (exact recovery of Paper III Theorem 1b at A_nr -> 0 and closed-cycle odd-elastic work identity across 2,000 cavities with zero violations), and Theorem 2 (global Lyapunov convergence of phase-kink-addressed topological soliton Ising / XY spin-glass machines within 38 ps with 96.4% ground-state success probability on 100-vertex MAX-CUT graphs).
